GNB.note: Training is for young people, not civil servants.

facts.fact: O Democrata GB reports the government and Telecel signed a memorandum on 23 April 2026 to launch the STARTOCODE learning platform, with the government committing to train 1,000 young people a year, 4,000 over four years, coordinated by the transport and digital economy ministry; no number trained is stated.

systems.platform: online learning platform and local centres

GNB.note: A 40 per cent quota for women and disabled people in a training programme; nothing on accessible information or digital services.
